weekly_objective: Get back to riding safely after nearly three weeks of minimal training, rebuilding aerobic volume and reintroducing heavy strength while HRV is below baseline.
coach_says: Monday to Wednesday didn't happen and your HRV has slipped to unbalanced (7-day average 43 ms, just under your 44-57 baseline, with resting HR creeping up). So I've shortened Friday's long ride to 2 hours and turned Saturday's threshold intervals into a gentler tempo session plus re-entry Workout A. Tuesday's rides are not being made up. If the missed days were down to illness, or you feel run down, keep everything in Z1-2 or rest, and we'll pick up properly with next Tuesday's committed rides.

days.details:
Warmup: 300 m - 200 m easy free + 4x25 m drill (catch-up / fingertip drag), 15 s rest
Main set: 6x100 m steady aerobic free at RPE 4-5, 20 s rest
Cooldown: 100 m easy choice
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Get moving again after the week off with low-impact aerobic work that leaves you fresh for Tuesday's committed rides.

days.session: Committed double: AM controlled hills + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM (before work):
60 min | Controlled hill ride, aerobic strength | Z2 with climbs at Z3, cap RPE 6
Warm-up: 15 min Z2
Main: 4 climbs of 5-6 min at Z3 (seated, 70-80 rpm), easy Z1-2 descent/spin between
Cool-down: 10 min Z1-2
Showers and gusts to 29 km/h: lights on, descend cautiously. If roads are flooded or heavy rain hits, ride the same structure on Zwift.

PM (after work):
90 min | Hard MTB group ride | RPE 7-9 efforts as the group dictates
First hard ride after 10 days off: ride the first 20 min conservatively, then join the surges.
Fuel: 1 bottle with 30-60 g carbs, plus a snack between rides.
days.fallback: If HRV is below 44 ms and resting HR is 56+ bpm (or sleep is poor): replace the AM hills with a 30-45 min Z1 spin or skip it. Ride the PM group ride sitting in and let surges go rather than chasing. Skip both only if you have illness symptoms (fever, chest symptoms).

days.details: 45 min gentle flow: hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine and glutes, with 5 min of breathing at the end. Drizzle forecast, so stay indoors. Keep it fully restorative after Tuesday's double.

60 min | Aerobic endurance + skills | Z2, RPE 3-4
Warm-up: 10 min Z1-2
Main: 45 min steady Z2 on flowing trails; practise smooth cornering and line choice, no hard efforts on climbs
Cool-down: 5 min Z1
Overcast and dry, wind to 25 km/h: good trail conditions.

120 min | Aerobic base rebuild after ~3 weeks off | Z2, RPE 3-4
Warm-up: 15 min Z1-2
Main: 95 min steady Z2; stay seated and in Z2 on climbs, no surges. Head out into the wind (up to 21 km/h) and come home with it behind you.
Cool-down: 10 min easy Z1
Best riding day of the weekend: mild (16-21°C), only light drizzle risk (0.1 mm).
Fuel: 40-60 g carbs per hour from the start, 1 bottle per hour.
If you wake with HRV under 41 ms or resting HR 56+ bpm, cut to 75-90 min Z1-2. If you feel unwell, rest.

days.session: AM indoor tempo + PM Workout A
days.details:
AM (indoor trainer, thunderstorm and gusts to 39 km/h):
50 min | Aerobic re-entry with a tempo touch (downgraded from threshold) | Z2 with Z3 blocks at 80-88% FTP, RPE 5-6
Warm-up: 12 min progressive Z1-Z2 incl. 2x30 s high cadence
Main: 3x6 min Z3, 3 min Z2 recovery between, then 8 min steady Z2
Cool-down: 6 min Z1

PM (6+ h after the ride):
Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min easy bike, hip/ankle mobility, 2 ramp-up sets on squat
Back Squat 3x6 (re-entry: start ~15% below last working load, 3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (3 RIR)
Single-arm Dumbbell Row 3x8/side (2 RIR)
Pallof Press 3x10/side
Side Plank 3x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets, 60-90 s on accessories
Objective: Reintroduce heavy lower-body loading after a long break without soreness that compromises next Tuesday's committed rides.
days.fallback: If HRV is below 41 ms or still unbalanced with resting HR 56+ bpm, or sleep was poor: ride 50 min steady Z2 indoors with no tempo blocks, and do Workout A with 2 sets per lift at 4 RIR. If you have any illness symptoms, rest completely.

days.details:
90 min | Aerobic volume, easy legs after Saturday | Z1-2, RPE 2-4
Warm-up: 10 min Z1
Main: 70 min relaxed Z2 on sheltered, tree-covered trails out of the wind (gusts to 36 km/h); no efforts on climbs
Cool-down: 10 min Z1
Drizzle likely (47%, 1.6 mm) and cool (12-17°C): bring a light shell and a bottle with carbs. If rain turns heavy or gusts make the trails unsafe, ride 60 min Z2 on Zwift instead.
Optional: 15 min evening mobility (hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine) to replace Wednesday's missed yoga.
